translated: All right, let's keep moving through these.
Next, we have one from Radio name: Yusuke Enaoshi.
"This is the first time I've sent in listener mail."
"What I look forward to in autumn is going for walks while feeling the cool breeze."
"I don't handle heat very well, so I don't feel like going out in summer unless I have to, but once autumn comes and it gets cooler, I go for walks quite often.
Seeing the autumn leaves and the sunsets during those walks is very healing.
Last year, the period where it actually felt cool was so short that I didn't get to walk much,
so I hope I can go for lots of walks this year."
I love going for walks too.
I try to walk as much as I can normally, but yeah, summer is definitely tough.
